verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships in-product AI insights. AskFred is an AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about your meeting transcripts, and the product generates detailed notes, action items and customized summaries after every meeting. It also offers conversation intelligence and team analytics. Missing for 10: proactive AI suggestions or recommendations beyond action items, in-depth docs on the depth of AskFred's insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
